lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Whoa! It flew right into it! Didn't even flinch!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: The charge cooked its engine cells. No burn, no steering. It's just drifting.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: It's dead in the water! Sit there and think about what you did.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: And it never saw the charge. Heat and motion, nothing else. Nanda called it.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Then we stay cold, let the passage stop them, and finish them where they float.
